test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BONE' is written as '619189', and 'CASH' is written as '752312'. How will 'DAWN' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**'BONE' is written as '619189',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aa8d1c69188a1a9d2a5cbcfa1ee2a1e4f4e9cb12e0289ec961cb6631c43fa336.png] 

**'CASH' is written as '752312',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8248555c70149d8065de5da9b48cde2f7224c200e0b42d185c4f8175d46b8808.png] 

Similarly,

**'DAWN' can be written as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17a724ff5d8a456c644c94e41cf06dd59ee985a1ad8b7cc5979e128a70565936.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****852718"**.
